data.exact_reserve_text: Claims development is shown in the tables below, both gross and net of reinsurance ceded, on an underwriting year basis. Balances have been translated at exchange rates prevailing at 31 December 2015 in all cases.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prioryear reserve release of approximately GBP 54.9m (around 15.9% of opening gross claims outstanding) driven by favourable claims development across older underwriting years (notably 2011-2013). This result is evidenced by the gross claims development table which shows reductions in the latest estimates versus the prior diagonal for those years. The release is reflected across multiple classes (net breakout shows significant releases in Marine/Aviation & Miscellaneous, with pockets of strengthening in Third Party Liability and Accident & Health).
raw_causal_phrases: good claims experience for Global Casualty during the year.
Overall performance in this segment in 2015 has deteriorated as a result of losses over most classes.
The Company has taken advantage of the transitional rules of FRS 103 that permit only five years of information to be disclosed upon adoption.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prioryear development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross figures) on page 39. The PYD figure is a triangle-derived gross amount (-GBP 54.854m release). LOB movements were not provided on a gross basis; net prior year movements by class were used (Note 8) and mapped to standard LOB names where reasonable - these are NET figures and mapping is approximate. Where only net per-LOB figures were available, confidence is reduced and this is noted above.
